BiblicalUsage: A fugitive is a man running from fear into a worse trap. Jeremiah says he that flees from the fear shall fall into the pit, and he that climbs out of the pit shall be taken in the snare — for Moab, the year of visitation leaves no way out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe running from God only runs into God: the fear, the pit, and the snare are all in the same road.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
